\section{Design Rationale}
\label{sec:design-rationale}

\subsection{Architectural Drivers}
% [Member D] List and prioritise the quality attributes that drove the architecture.

The architecture is shaped by the following quality attributes, listed in
priority order:

\begin{enumerate}
  \item \textbf{Reproducibility} -- every experiment must be re-runnable from
        version-controlled code and data snapshots.
  \item \textbf{Scalability} -- training jobs and serving endpoints must scale
        independently.
  \item \textbf{Reliability} -- the serving path must remain available even
        when the training subsystem is degraded.
  \item \textbf{Maintainability} -- teams must be able to evolve any component
        without touching the others.
  \item \textbf{Observability} -- the state of every model in production must
        be visible at a glance.
\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Key Design Decisions}
% [Member D] ADR-style table: decision, alternatives considered, rationale.

\begin{longtable}{@{}L{2.8cm}L{4.5cm}L{7.0cm}@{}}
\caption{Architectural decision records.}
\label{tab:adrs}\\
\toprule
\textbf{Decision} & \textbf{Alternatives} & \textbf{Rationale} \\
\midrule
\endfirsthead
\toprule
\textbf{Decision} & \textbf{Alternatives} & \textbf{Rationale} \\
\midrule
\endhead
Centralised model registry &
  File-share; database-only &
  Provides lineage, stage governance, and a stable API for downstream
  consumers without coupling them to storage details. \\
\addlinespace
Event-driven retraining &
  Scheduled cron; manual trigger &
  Decouples drift detection from the training scheduler.
  New detectors can be added without changing the pipeline. \\
\addlinespace
Separate serving cluster &
  Co-locate training and serving &
  Prevents training jobs from starving latency-sensitive inference
  requests; allows independent scaling. \\
\addlinespace
Feature store &
  Compute features on demand &
  Eliminates training-serving skew by sharing the same feature
  computation logic across both paths. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\subsection{Constraints}
% [Member D] Document constraints (team size, budget, technology choices).

The design operates within the following constraints:
\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{OC-01} -- The platform must run on a single cloud provider.
  \item \textbf{OC-02} -- The engineering team has seven members.
  \item \textbf{OC-03} -- Open-source tooling is preferred to reduce licensing costs.
  \item \textbf{TC-01} -- Model inference latency must not exceed 200\,ms at
        the 95th percentile.
\end{itemize}
